messages.subject: [statnet_help] Problems with valued ergm
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

I am having problems with calculating valued ergms and would really appreciate your help.
I?m getting an error message that I don?t understand. In [statnet_help] the same error message appeared in ?Valued models with missing edges?. As far as I grasp it, there is something else causing the same message. I only have one missing edge and when I impute the modal value for this NA the same error occurs.

Description of the data:
It?s a school class of 16 pupils. Nodeattributes are gender, age, special educational needs status [IS], and self-concept in sports. The dependent variable are interactions in Physical Education with 0 = almost no interaction up to 4 = interact very often.

The ergm command is:
est <- ergm(playNet ~ sum + mutual("min") + nodeisqrtcovar + nodeosqrtcovar
         + nodematch("gender", diff = F, form = "sum")
         + nodeifactor("IS", base = 1) + nodeofactor("IS", base = 1)
         + transitiveweights("min", "max", "min"), response= "count",
         reference=~Binomial(4))

The error message I get is:

Error in if (is.null(message) && nonnegative && any(nw %e% response <  :

  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

  multiple = FALSE

    age gender IS sport vertex.names

    count

Do you have any suggestions of what I?m doing wrong? Any help is much appreciated!

Thanks and best wishes,
Fabian
